name: rnd-pmo
description: Products, projects and the weekly R&D report: project health rules, report format, release notes, weekly schedule. / 产品、项目和研发周报：健康度规则、周报格式、版本说明、每周定时。

body.en:
{target}

Follow this skill's weekly report steps for last Monday to Sunday: read the bounded windows, check coverage, update project health, and write the report as a draft. Then tell me what needs a decision.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的周报步骤处理上周一到周日：按范围读取、检查覆盖、更新项目健康度，写成周报草稿。然后告诉我有哪些需要拍板。

body.en:
{target}

Apply this skill's health rules to every live project and write a two-sentence latest update for each. Tell me which ones changed and why.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的健康度规则检查每个进行中的项目，并各写两句话的最新进展。告诉我哪些变了、为什么。

label.en: Check a report against the records
label.zh-CN: 核对周报和记录是否一致

body.en:
{target}

Re-read the records for the latest weekly report's period and list every line or number in the report that the records do not support. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

重新读取最新一份周报周期内的记录，列出周报里每一处与记录对不上的句子或数字。不要修改任何记录。

label.en: Add a new rule to the report playbook
label.zh-CN: 把新定的规矩写进周报手册

body.en:
{target}

Fold the rule I describe into this skill's SKILL.md where it belongs, keeping the rest unchanged, and show me the diff before proposing the change.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

把我说的新规矩写进这份 SKILL.md 合适的位置，其余内容保持不变，提交变更前先给我看改动。

label.en: Explain how the weekly loop works

body.en:
{target}

Explain this skill to a team lead: what the weekly report contains, where each number comes from, how health is set, and how to schedule it. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

给团队负责人讲清这份手册：周报包含什么、每个数字从哪来、健康度怎么定、怎么设置每周定时。不要修改任何记录。
